newsitem.title: USA: Delgratia can trade on other systems.
newsitem.headline: Delgratia can trade on other systems.

text.p: Although Delgratia Mining Corp will no longer be allowed to trade on Nasdaq's smallcap market, the stock is eligible to trade on the Over-The-Counter Bulletin Board or the pink sheets, Nasdaq said Thursday.
"I think they would want to do that immediately so there would be a seamless transition," said a spokesman for the electronic stock market.
Delgratia's stockholders would not be affected by the move to another system, he said.
The British Columbia, Vancouver mining concern will have 45 days to appeal Nasdaq's decision to delist them, effective at close of business.
In Vancouver, Delgratia had no immediate comment on the Nasdaq move but the company's public relations firm said it hoped to issue a statement later.
